name: Wallet deposit drains sync and HTTP logging queues
description: Issue #9: deposit to the synthetic player's main wallet, then sync to SBO via HubWalletSync and capture the resulting httplog document.

queries.name: main_wallet
queries.sql: SELECT w.balance, w.freeze FROM wallets w JOIN users u ON u.id = w.user_id JOIN stations s ON s.id = u.station_id JOIN platforms p ON p.id = w.platform_id WHERE u.account = ? AND s.code = ? AND p.name = ? AND w.currency = ?

queries.name: game_wallet
queries.sql: SELECT w.balance, w.freeze FROM wallets w JOIN users u ON u.id = w.user_id JOIN stations s ON s.id = u.station_id JOIN platforms p ON p.id = w.platform_id WHERE u.account = ? AND s.code = ? AND p.name = ? AND w.currency = ?

queries.name: deposit_record
queries.sql: SELECT trade_no, amount, status, stage FROM deposit_records WHERE trade_no = ?

queries.name: remittance
queries.sql: SELECT r.amount, r.status, r.stage FROM remittance_records r JOIN users u ON u.id = r.user_id JOIN stations s ON s.id = u.station_id WHERE u.account = ? AND s.code = ? ORDER BY r.id

queries.name: failed_jobs
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS failed_count FROM failed_jobs
